candidate_workaround: Resolve or name the full remote-tracking ref explicitly and pass that ref to Git revision-range commands.
failure_signature: PowerShell transforms an upstream expression embedded in a Git revision range.
recurrence_guard: Never embed an unquoted upstream hashtable-like expression in a PowerShell revision range.
rollback: Stop the bounded probe, retain the failure, and return to the last clean repository state without external mutation.
scope_boundary: Preferred only for the declared local workflow trigger; it grants no scientific, professional, authority, production, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Explicit remote-ref revision-range equality
trigger_preconditions: A Git equality range uses an upstream expression inside PowerShell command text.
